note: Unmodified RCSB PDB entries, used by the test suite and the tutorials. Each file's SHA-256 is recorded so a changed copy is detectable; RCSB remediates entries over time, so a fresh download can differ from these bytes.

structures.description: Human ubiquitin, 1.8 Å crystal structure: one protein chain (A, 76 residues), standard amino acids only; waters are the only HETATM records; no alternate locations, insertion codes or extra models.
structures.used_for: protein Cα TSR and its modifiers; SSE-TSR (2 HELIX and 5 SHEET records); amino-acid atomic TSR (LEU 15 is a complete interior residue; the C-terminal GLY 76 carries OXT and is excluded by the historical exact-atom-count rule).

structures.description: Barnase–barstar complex, three copies per asymmetric unit (A/B/C barnase, D/E/F barstar, per the COMPND records); 21 HELIX and 23 SHEET records.
structures.used_for: protein–protein cross TSR (A with D); SSE-TSR.

structures.target: BEN (benzamidine), residue 1, chain A; the single CA (calcium) HETATM is not a ligand target
structures.used_for: drug (ligand) TSR and drug–protein cross TSR.

structures.description: B-DNA dodecamer (Dickerson–Drew), two complementary DNA chains, no protein. The 5'-terminal DC of chain A lacks its phosphate atoms, so the historical exact-atom-count rule drops it.
p53 core domain bound to DNA: protein chains A/B/C and DNA chains E/F; 10 HELIX and 33 SHEET records (β-sandwich).

Nucleosome core particle: histone chains A–H (standard amino acids only) and DNA strands I–J (DA/DC/DG/DT only); 38 HELIX records. Its dense interface contains distinct atoms that share a (side, atom name) pair, which is what distinguishes full physical atom identity from the historical pool identity.
structures.used_for: nucleotide–protein cross TSR and cross atom identity; helix-heavy SSE-TSR.

structures.description: Glycoprotein with an N-linked NAG at chain A residue 1, and a NAG–NAG–FUC chain.
structures.target: NAG, residue 1, chain A (14 heavy atoms, so C(14,3) = 364 triangles)
structures.used_for: carbohydrate TSR and carbohydrate-chain TSR, including mirror.

structures.description: p53 tetramer bound to DNA (complex I); chain A has 198 Cα atoms.
structures.target: DNA: DT/DC in chain E, DA in chain F
structures.used_for: protein Cα reproduction of the historical program on a larger chain; nucleotide TSR; nucleotide–protein cross TSR.

structures.description: CDK2/cyclin A complexed with a pyrazolopyridazine inhibitor; chain A has 295 Cα atoms.
structures.used_for: protein Cα reproduction on a larger chain; protein–protein cross TSR.

structures.description: MAPK1 (ERK2) with a fragment-derived inhibitor; chain A has 341 Cα atoms and six CYS.
structures.used_for: protein Cα reproduction on a larger chain; drug TSR; amino-acid atomic TSR.

structures.description: Hyperglycosylated human IgG1 Fc (Fc329); chain A has 207 Cα atoms.
structures.target: NAG residues 1, 2 and 5 in chain D
structures.used_for: protein Cα reproduction on a larger chain; carbohydrate TSR; carbohydrate–protein cross TSR.
